fixture.server: single Node process with file-backed SQLite WAL, separate client process on one 4-vCPU quota host
fixture.map: 512 x 256; 6,000 aged glyphs, 75% of them width 2, sampled ages distributed over 180 seconds
fixture.worldClock: actual elapsed time after pre-seeding; natural stochastic resize choices and scheduling are independent on each run
fixture.defaultRoles: 2% writers (3 inputs/s with jitter), 8% moving in bursts, rest stationary except replacement
fixture.replacement: one reader per 20 minutes per concurrent participant on average; await socket close before opening its replacement
fixture.plaza: starting positions in 33x17 cells, then normal input and navigation
fixture.sourceDigest: SHA-256 over the filename and file bytes of each .js in server then shared, each directory sorted; before/after release samples match commits; frame-300-plaza is an intermediate working-tree candidate
fixture.surge: 45s at six writers, 45s at 75, 45s at six; all 300 initially in the plaza, 24 walkers throughout, each writer ~3 actions/s.
fixture.surgeBaseline: unweighted-surge is the partial trace of the first admission design which exceeded its 210s execution deadline.

metricDefinitions.scheduledAckP95Ms: scheduled open-loop offer to author ACK, ms
metricDefinitions.ackP95Ms: actual send to author ACK, ms
metricDefinitions.readyP95Ms: start of action/delivery to server WebSocket write, ms
metricDefinitions.otherDecodeP95Ms: correlated remote visible nonempty glyph versions in partial views that also carry their author, at stationary readers, send to parsed message. One in 16 stationary slots sampled for a one-hour run. No browser paint or internet RTT.
metricDefinitions.revisionGaps: forward per-socket observation gaps outside explicit reset; not a full-world delivery oracle
metricDefinitions.audits: ordinary sync on four sentinel slots compares their reconstructed client state to a complete server observation at the same sequence
metricDefinitions.delivery.undelivered_events: pending events removed when the socket closes or the write cannot proceed; includes planned departures
metricDefinitions.eventLoopP99: runtime monitor at finish, reset by routine minute samples; not a whole-run p99
metricDefinitions.peakRss: storage samples at startup, every minute and finish; not instantaneous memory maximum
metricDefinitions.meanRssGiB: trapezoidal time-weighted process RSS, 2^30 bytes per GiB
metricDefinitions.serverBytesPerSecond: uncompressed WebSocket application payload measured on the server; excludes framing, TLS and retransmission

railway.operatorChannel: bounded real WS participants from an authenticated private loopback runner; external Chromium clients use public HTTPS/WSS
railway.releaseModelUnits: Published rate per GB; the new model treats GB as 1,000,000,000 bytes, converts measured binary RSS/volume units. The Railway metrics API reports the cgroup cap 8,000,000,000 bytes as 8 GB. The legacy scenarios and operator metering use GiB.
